findings.failure_path: Semver correctness is asserted (backward-compatible capabilities already on dev) but the frozen packet contains no source or skill-content delta, so a breaking removal or rename of a shipped skill would still ship as a minor bump and nothing in the packet can falsify it.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the origin/dev...HEAD content delta (or a diffed list of shipped skill files vs 0.12.0) as evidence so the minor bump is checkable.

findings.failure_path: Package-contents acceptance cannot be checked: only lines 1-6 of the manifest are visible, so files/bin/exports/publishConfig/dependencies are invisible. A stale or over-broad files glob would ship unintended content at 0.13.0 while the review still reports green on an unverifiable test-count claim.
findings.smallest_fix: Add npm pack --dry-run file-list output for 0.13.0 vs 0.12.0 to the packet, or expand the manifest hunk context.

findings.failure_path: Observability/rollback gap: the published version pointer advances with no CHANGELOG or release-notes entry, so after publish there is no in-repo artifact stating what 0.13.0 contains and a rollback decision (deprecate/republish 0.12.0) has no recorded basis.
findings.smallest_fix: Add the 0.13.0 CHANGELOG/release-notes entry in this same candidate so the version pointer and its description land atomically.

findings.failure_path: Gate-fireability: only convention binds this bump to the claimed protected release path. A later actor can push a v0.13.0 tag or run npm publish directly from dev, skipping the merge-to-main step; the diff adds no check that the manifest version equals the tag or that HEAD is on main.
findings.smallest_fix: Assert version==tag and branch==main as publish-workflow preconditions, or cite the existing enforced check, rather than relying on the release-boundary claim.

But the packet cannot support the checks it claims to satisfy — semver correctness (no source delta justifying minor vs major), package contents (files/bin/exports not visible), and release observability/rollback (no CHANGELOG or workflow change).
